title: Built Heritage Committee - September 09, 2025
meeting_location: Champlain Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on September 24, 2025 in Built Heritage Committee Report 25.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on September 8, 2025, and the deadline to register by email to speak is 8:30 am on September 9, 2025.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:

Correspondence was received from Ms Linda Hoad, Heritage Ottawa, and from Mr. Mark Heckman, President, Goulbourn Township Historical Society.  Both submissions are held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.

sub_agendas_items.title: Designation of the Former Royal Canadian Air Force Officers’ Mess, 158 Gloucester Street under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act

attachments.attachment_title: 4.7 ACS2025-PDB-RHU-0039 - Designation of 158 Gloucester former RCAF mess .pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Correspondence was received from Ms Linda Hoad, Heritage Ottawa, and from Ms Ana Stuermer, Chief Urban Planner and Manager, Portfolio Planning, Department of National Defence.  Both submissions are held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.
Vice-Chair Plante introduced the following Motion as a technical amendment to the report recommendations to correct two minor errors.
Ms Lesley Collins, Program Manager, Heritage Planning, Planning, Development and Building Services (PDBS) Department, introduced Mr. Ben Morin, Planner II, PDBS.  In response to comments from Committee, she also spoke to provide context for the report. 
Discussions having concluded, the report recommendations were put before Committee and were ‘Carried’ as presented, with Member Bourns dissenting.

motions.motion_text:
Report Recommendation(s)
That the Built Heritage Committee recommend that Council issue a Notice of Intention to Designate 158 Gloucester Street under Part IV of theOntario Heritage Actaccording to the Statement of Cultural Heritage Value attached as Document 4.
Carried as amended with Member Bourn dissenting.

WHEREAS in Document 4, The Statement of Cultural Heritage Value for 158 Gloucester Street includes two minor errors in the Description of Heritage Attributes;
